run_main: run offline inference with vLLM for vision language models using command line arguments
run_parse_args: parse command line arguments for model type, modality, number of prompts and tensor parallel size
run_get_multi_modal_input: get multi-modal input data including image or video assets with sample questions
run_model_example_map: run inference for a specified vision language model from the model example map
run_apply_image_repeat: apply image repeat with configurable probability to simulate multimodal preprocessor cache hits
